# Independent synthetic comparison fixtures

Generated locally with Python/Pillow 12.2.0 by `generate.py`; no network, personal data, credentials, real provider output or original discovery image. These test-only vectors use an explicit fixed seed and the documented v1 raster specification, independently implemented in Python. Future experiments must use a fresh random nonce instead.

- `independent.png`: RGB8 PNG with a bounded plain Software text chunk; independent lossless reference.
- `independent-q85.jpg`: Pillow progressive JPEG quality85, subsampling2 (4:2:0); legitimate different encoded bytes.
- `animated.png`: two-frame APNG; unsupported negative control.
- `metadata-over.png`: valid RGB PNG with 65,536 comment bytes plus framing; exceeds the 64 KiB metadata policy before native work.

Pillow is optional fixture-regeneration tooling, not an application/test-run dependency. Tests load the committed generated bytes. Production uses only the existing pinned Sharp dependency. The independent raster/cell vector and Pillow container help catch shared generator/decoder assumptions; the JPEG encoders can still share underlying libjpeg behavior and are not independent security proofs.
